{"comments":[{"category":"bug","content":"`execute_mcp_direct` silently forwards `serde_json::Value::Null` to the MCP server when the model produces malformed JSON for `args`. The remote server then returns a type/argument-shape error and the model wastes a round seeing a downstream confusion with no signal that the upstream string was unparseable — exactly the kind of opaque failure the severity-classifier pipeline exists to surface but cannot when the error is preempted here. The e2e test even pins this behaviour as a feature (\"Null arguments 也应到达远端\") but that is the wrong default for malformed input — it conflates \"model wrote `null` deliberately\" with \"model wrote garbage\". If a server disconnects (or connects) between the tool-list emission at the top of a model loop and a tool dispatch a few iterations later, the model may invoke a function name that no longer exists in the mount table (or, less dangerously, vice versa). The file header advertises a single \"构建结果\" shared by schema and dispatch, but in practice two independent snapshots are taken. 1|//! MCP 外部工具挂载层（阶段 3，拍板 2A 机制 A）：连接槽 × 工具快照 → agent 工具清单。
2|//!
3|//! 职责（纯增量，不动内置 32 工具的任何注册路径）：
4|//! - `mcp_mounted_tools()`：当前可挂载条目（函数名已消歧、schema 已整形）
5|//! - `mcp_tools_json_body()`：拼进主 agent tools JSON 尾部的动态段
6|//! - `find_mounted(func_name)`：阶段 4 dispatch 反查（函数名 → 服务器 id + 原始工具名）
7|//!
8|//! 命名：`mcp_{服务器前缀}_{工具名}`（config::mcp_tool_name，64 字节硬上限内）。
9|//! 不同服务器净化后前缀相同且工具同名会撞名——`build_mounted_tools` 按构建序
10|//! 加 `_2`/`_3` 序号消歧，schema 与 dispatch 反查共用同一份构建结果，不漂移。
11|//!
12|//! 会话边界：MCP 工具只进**主 agent** 清单（registry::tools_json_with_mcp 对
13|//! 子 agent 会话短路返回白名单——设计 §5.1：子 agent 工具面静态、可枚举、可审计）。

16|
17|use rmcp::model::{CallToolResult, Tool};

24|/// 单个可挂载的外部工具条目（schema 与反查的单一来源）
25|#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
26|pub struct McpMountedTool {
27|    /// agent 看到的 function 名（消歧后）
28|    pub func_name: String,
29|    /// 来源服务器配置 id（挂载反查回 `config::io` 按 id 取配置 + call 路由）
30|    pub server_id: String,
31|    /// 来源服务器显示名（错误文案/描述兜底用，区别于 id）
32|    pub server_name: String,
33|    /// 服务器侧原始工具名（调用时透传）
34|    pub tool_name: String,
35|    /// OpenAI function schema（parameters = 服务器给的 inputSchema 原样）
36|    pub schema: serde_json::Value,
37|}
38|
39|/// 工具结果文本总长上限（fetch_url 同口径，防爆上下文）
40|const MAX_RESULT_CHARS: usize = 30_000;
41|
42|/// 单工具 schema 序列化体积上限（字节）。B0-2（AUDIT-FIX-PLAN-2026-09-29）：
43|/// inputSchema 服务器侧原样透传，无上限会每轮全量拼进 tools JSON。超限不丢
44|/// 工具（保功能）：参数 schema 降级为宽松空对象，模型按描述调用、服务器侧校验兜底。
45|const MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024;
46|
47|/// 描述整形：trim + 512 字符截断 + 缺省兜底（描述是模型选工具的主要依据，
48|/// 超长服务器描述不能挤爆主上下文）
49|fn shape_description(server_name: &str, t: &Tool) -> String {
50|    let from_server = t
51|        .description
52|        .as_deref()
53|        .map(str::trim)
54|        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty());
55|    let desc = match from_server {
56|        Some(d) => d.to_string(),
57|        None => format!("外部 MCP 工具（服务器：{server_name}）"),
58|    };
59|    desc.chars().take(512).collect()
60|}
61|
62|/// 构建单条挂载 schema（纯函数）：parameters 用服务器 inputSchema 原样
63|/// （类型上恒为 object Map；空 Map 也是合法空 schema）。
64|/// B0-2：序列化超 MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES 时降级——宽松空参数 + 描述标注，不丢工具。
65|fn tool_schema(server_name: &str, func_name: &str, t: &Tool) -> serde_json::Value {
66|    let desc = shape_description(server_name, t);
67|    let params = serde_json::Value::Object((*t.input_schema).clone());
68|    let schema = json!({
69|        "type": "function",
70|        "function": {
71|            "name": func_name,
72|            "description": desc.clone(),
73|            "parameters": params,
74|        }
75|    });
76|    let oversized = serde_json::to_string(&schema)
77|        .map(|s| s.len() > MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES)
78|        .unwrap_or(true);
79|    if oversized {
80|        return json!({
81|            "type": "function",
82|            "function": {
83|                "name": func_name,
84|                "description": format!("{desc}（inputSchema 过大已省略，按无固定参数调用）"),
85|                "parameters": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true },
86|            }
87|        });
88|    }
89|    schema
90|}
91|
92|/// 64 字节函数名钳制（消歧后缀可能顶破上限）：超限时尾部 8 字节换 6 位哈希。
93|/// 与 config::mcp_tool_name 同款套路；输入恒 ASCII，按字节截断安全。
94|fn clamp_fn_name(name: String) -> String {
95|    const MAX: usize = 64;
96|    if name.len() <= MAX {
97|        return name;
98|    }
99|    use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
100|    let mut h = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
101|    name.hash(&mut h);
102|    let suffix = format!("{:06x}", h.finish() & 0xffffff);
103|    let keep = MAX - suffix.len() - 1;
104|    format!("{}_{suffix}", &name[..keep])
105|}
106|
107|/// 构建挂载条目（纯函数内核，单测直打）。函数名全局唯一：
108|/// 同 base 撞名按构建序加 `_2`/`_3`；后缀撞到**真实工具名**也继续递增
109|///（P2-1 评审：A 服务器有 "read" 和 "read 2"、B 服务器（同前缀）有 "read" 时，
110|/// 朴素计数会产出两个 mcp_p_read_2）——used 集合查重保证 schema 无重名。
111|pub fn build_mounted_tools(
112|    servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)],
113|) -> Vec<McpMountedTool> {
114|    let mut used: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
115|    let mut out = Vec::new();
116|    for (server_id, server_name, tools) in servers {
117|        for t in tools {
118|            let base = mcp_tool_name(server_name, t.name.as_ref());
119|            let mut n = 1usize;
120|            let mut func = base.clone();
121|            while !used.insert(func.clone()) {
122|                n += 1;
123|                func = clamp_fn_name(format!("{base}_{n}"));
124|            }
125|            out.push(McpMountedTool {
126|                schema: tool_schema(server_name, &func, t),
127|                func_name: func,
128|                server_id: server_id.clone(),
129|                server_name: server_name.clone(),
130|                tool_name: t.name.to_string(),
131|            });
132|        }
133|    }
134|    out
135|}
136|
137|/// 当前可挂载条目（读全局连接槽；无连接 → 空表）
138|pub fn mcp_mounted_tools() -> Vec<McpMountedTool> {
139|    build_mounted_tools(&shared().mounted())
140|}
141|
142|/// dispatch 反查（阶段 4）：函数名 → 挂载条目（拿 server_id 查配置、tool_name 调远端）。
143|/// 现场重建挂载表做线性查——每轮模型循环最多 miss 一次才走到这，开销可忽略。
144|pub fn find_mounted(func_name: &str) -> Option<McpMountedTool> {
145|    mcp_mounted_tools().into_iter().find(|t| t.func_name == func_name)
146|}

148|// ───────────────────────── 阶段 4：dispatch 路由桥 ─────────────────────────
149|
150|/// dispatch 查表 miss 时的 MCP 兜底路由。
151|/// 边界（全部由上游保证，此处不重复）：
152|/// - 子 agent 会话到不了这里——dispatch 的白名单闸在查表前已拒（MCP 工具不在任何 profile 白名单）；
153|/// - 审计由 execute_tool_impl 统一包（tool.call / tool.return 已发出）。
154|/// 服务器删除/禁用/未连接都是**文本返回**（仓库惯例：不炸主循环，模型拿到
155|/// 明确错误自己绕开）；只有反查不到挂载表（模型编造的工具名）走 Error 状态。
156|pub(crate) async fn execute_mcp_tool(
157|    app: &tauri::AppHandle,
158|    name: &str,
159|    args: &str,
160|) -> crate::bot::registry::ToolResult {
161|    let Some(mounted) = find_mounted(name) else {
162|        return crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::error(
163|            format!("未知工具：{name}"),
164|            Vec::new(),
165|        );
166|    };
167|    let server = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(app)
168|        .mcp_servers
169|        .unwrap_or_default()
170|        .into_iter()
171|        .find(|s| s.id == mounted.server_id);
172|    match server {
173|        Some(cfg) if cfg.enabled => execute_mcp_direct(&cfg, &mounted, args).await,
174|        Some(_) => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
175|            format!(
176|                "MCP 服务器「{}」已被禁用，工具 {name} 不可用；下轮清单刷新后不再出现",
177|                mounted.server_name
178|            ),
179|            Vec::new(),
180|        ),
181|        None => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
182|            format!(
183|                "MCP 服务器「{}」已被删除，工具 {name} 不可用；下轮清单刷新后不再出现",
184|                mounted.server_name
185|            ),
186|            Vec::new(),
187|        ),
188|    }
189|}

191|/// 调用内核（无 AppHandle，单测直打）：带超时调远端 + 结果整形。
192|pub(crate) async fn execute_mcp_direct(
193|    cfg: &McpServerConfig,
194|    mounted: &McpMountedTool,
195|    args: &str,
196|) -> crate::bot::registry::ToolResult {
197|    let parsed: serde_json::Value =
198|        serde_json::from_str(args).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
199|    match shared().call_tool(cfg, &mounted.tool_name, parsed).await {
200|        Ok(result) => {
201|            if result.is_error == Some(true) {
202|                crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
203|                    format!("MCP 工具报告错误：\n{}", shape_result_text(&result)),
204|                    Vec::new(),
205|                )
206|            } else {
207|                crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::ok(shape_result_text(&result), Vec::new())
208|            }
209|        }
210|        // 失败走 ok 文本返回（severity classifier 误判 fatal 防御，与仓库惯例一致）；
211|        // 首字「MCP」非 error/warn 前缀，机械判定按 ok 处理
212|        Err(e) => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::ok(
213|            format!("MCP 调用失败：{e}"),
214|            Vec::new(),
215|        ),
216|    }
217|}
218|
219|/// CallToolResult → 模型可读文本：text 内容原样拼接，非文本块占位说明，
220|/// structuredContent 附后。总长钳 MAX_RESULT_CHARS（fetch_url 同口径，防爆上下文）。
221|fn shape_result_text(result: &CallToolResult) -> String {
222|    let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
223|    for block in &result.content {
224|        match block {
225|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Text(t) => parts.push(t.text.to_string()),
226|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Image(_) => {
227|                parts.push("（图片内容：本工具无法在文本回话中展示，请让用户直接查看）".into())
228|            }
229|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Audio(_) => parts.push("（音频内容，略）".into()),
230|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Resource(_) | rmcp::model::ContentBlock::ResourceLink(_) => {
231|                parts.push("（内嵌资源内容，略）".into())
232|            }
233|            // #[non_exhaustive]：协议升级新增内容类型时兜底
234|            _ => parts.push("（未知内容类型，略）".into()),
235|        }
236|    }
237|    if let Some(sc) = &result.structured_content {
238|        // B0-2（AUDIT-FIX-PLAN-2026-09-29）：先序列化按上限钳制再入栈（内存优化：
239|        // 超大 structuredContent 不先全量入 parts 再 join）；截断标注由下方
240|        // 整段截断统一给出（sc 钳到上限后加前缀必然再触发总长钳制）
241|        let mut s = sc.to_string();
242|        let n = s.chars().count();
243|        if n > MAX_RESULT_CHARS {
244|            s = s.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect();
245|        }
246|        parts.push(format!("[structuredContent] {s}"));
247|    }
248|    let mut text = if parts.is_empty() {
249|        "（工具执行完成，无返回内容）".to_string()
250|    } else {
251|        parts.join("\n")
252|    };
253|    let total = text.chars().count();
254|    if total > MAX_RESULT_CHARS {
255|        text = text.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect();
256|        text.push_str(&format!("\n\n（内容过长已截断：原 {total} 字符）"));
257|    }
258|    text
259|}

261|/// 拼进主 agent tools JSON 的动态段：`",\n  {schema}..."` 序列（空表 = 空串）。
262|/// registry::tools_json_with_mcp 把它插进静态 JSON 的尾部 `"\n]"` 之前。
263|pub fn mcp_tools_json_body() -> String {
264|    build_tools_json_body(&shared().mounted())
265|}

267|/// 同上（纯函数内核，单测直打）
268|pub fn build_tools_json_body(servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)]) -> String {
269|    let entries = build_mounted_tools(servers);
270|    let mut s = String::new();
271|    for e in &entries {
272|        s.push_str(",\n  ");
273|        s.push_str(&e.schema.to_string());
274|    }
275|    s
276|}

341|/// 工具名同样净化为 [a-z0-9_-]（非 ASCII → `_`）；全名超 64 字节

347|pub fn mcp_tool_name(server_name: &str, tool_name: &str) -> String {
348|    let prefix = tool_prefix(server_name);
349|    let tool: String = tool_name
350|        .trim()
351|        .chars()
352|        .map(|c| {
353|            if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-' {
354|                c.to_ascii_lowercase()
355|            } else {
356|                '_'
357|            }
358|        })
359|        .collect();
360|    let raw = format!("mcp_{prefix}_{tool}");
361|    if raw.len() <= MCP_TOOL_NAME_MAX_BYTES {
362|        return raw;
363|    }
364|    // 超长：整名哈希取 6 位十六进制尾；raw 已全 ASCII，按字节截断安全

367|    raw.hash(&mut h);
368|    let suffix = format!("{:06x}", h.finish() & 0xffffff);
369|    let keep = MCP_TOOL_NAME_MAX_BYTES - suffix.len() - 1;
370|    format!("{}_{suffix}", &raw[..keep])

+pub fn tools_json_with_mcp(session_id: Option<&str>) -> std::borrow::Cow<'static, str> {

+fn splice_mcp_body<'a>(base: &'a str, body: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'a, str> {
+    let Some(head) = base.strip_suffix("\n]") else {
+        return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(base);
+    };
+    let mut s = String::with_capacity(head.len() + body.len() + 2);
+    s.push_str(head);
+    s.push_str(body);
+    s.push_str("\n]");
+    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(s)
+}

Confirmed — `HashMap` is imported but never used in `mount.rs`. This is a warning that would normally be caught by `cargo build`, and it's a minor cleanup. Now let me look at a few more potential issues: ### Issue 2: `clamp_fn_name` byte-slicing safety Looking at line 104: `format!("{}_{suffix}", &name[..keep])`. The `name` input is `format!("{base}_{n}")`. Since `base = mcp_tool_name(...)` which returns ASCII-only output (we saw the `mcp_tool_name` function), this should be ASCII safe. But `keep = MAX - suffix.len() - 1 = 64 - 6 - 1 = 57`. Slicing `&name[..57]` on a guaranteed-ASCII string is safe. However, there's a subtle issue: `name.len()` checks byte length. But the name being constructed is `format!("{base}_{n}")` where `n` is a small integer (so `n.to_string()` is always 1-3 digits). So total length is at most `mcp_tool_name` length + 1 (underscore) + 3 (max "999") + 1 (max separator) ≈ 70 bytes max. But the check `name.len() <= MAX` is checked first, so only larger names enter the clamping path. Wait — this matters: After clamping, the result `format!("{}_{suffix}", &name[..keep])` will be at most `keep + 1 + suffix.len()` = `(MAX - suffix.len() - 1) + 1 + suffix.len()` = MAX bytes. So that's correct. But the comment says "尾部 8 字节换 6 位哈希". Wait, the suffix is 6 bytes (hex digits), and `format!("_{suffix}")` adds 1 underscore = 7 bytes total. The keep calculation gives `MAX - 6 - 1 = 57`. So we have `57 + 1 + 6 = 64 = MAX`. The comment says "尾部 8 字节换 6 位哈希" but actually it's only 7 bytes (`_` + 6 hex chars). The comment is slightly inaccurate but not a code issue. ### Issue 3: `shape_description` - the comment says "trim + 512 字符截断". But it calls `desc.chars().take(512).collect()`. This collects to a String — fine. The original comment in `mcp_tool_name` says similar clamping is "按字节截断安全" but here it's character-based. That's actually correct since characters could be multi-byte. ### Issue 4: Looking at `find_mounted` ```rust pub fn find_mounted(func_name: &str) -> Option<McpMountedTool> { mcp_mounted_tools().into_iter().find(|t| t.func_name == func_name) } ``` This rebuilds the entire mount table per call. This is already in the confirmed findings (issue #2). ### Issue 5: Looking at `execute_mcp_tool` Let me look at the closure variables in detail: ```rust let server = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(app) .mcp_servers .unwrap_or_default() .into_iter() .find(|s| s.id == mounted.server_id); ``` Here `mounted.server_id` is borrowed from `mounted` which is owned by `execute_mcp_tool`. The closure captures `mounted.server_id` by reference. Since `mounted` is used later in the match arms, this should be fine. But the iteration may be inefficient — it could be O(n) where n is the number of servers. For large configs this might matter, but it's fine for the size we're talking about (max MCP servers). ### Issue 6: Looking at error handling in `execute_mcp_direct` ```rust let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(args).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null); ``` This is already in confirmed findings (issue #3). ### Issue 7: Looking at `shape_result_text` There's potentially an inefficient/duplicate char counting: ```rust let n = s.chars().count(); if n > MAX_RESULT_CHARS { s = s.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect(); } ``` This first counts chars (O(n)), then if needed, takes MAX chars (also O(MAX)). For very large `structured_content`, the initial count is wasteful but not buggy. Minor. Actually wait, looking at the entire structured_content handling: ```rust let mut s = sc.to_string(); let n = s.chars().count(); if n > MAX_RESULT_CHARS { s = s.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect(); } parts.push(format!("[structuredContent] {s}")); ``` If `s` has 30,000 chars and gets pushed to parts with a prefix "[structuredContent] ", that adds 20 more chars. Then `parts.join("\n")` later, the total could exceed MAX_RESULT_CHARS. The total length truncation at the end catches this. But there's a subtle issue: the `take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS)` doesn't account for the prefix that's added later. The comment says "截断标注由下方整段截断统一给出" — meaning the full-text truncation is supposed to handle this. But if `s` is exactly at the max (30,000 chars) and we add a 20-byte prefix, the final text becomes ~30,020 chars before join, and after join with the structuredContent prefix included and any prefix from prior parts, it's truncated — and the truncation annotation claims "原 X 字符" which includes the prefix. This is a tiny issue. But there's a deeper issue: If `parts` is empty initially (no content blocks), and structuredContent is 30,000 chars (max-allowed), the parts become one entry: `[structuredContent] {30000 chars}`. Then text is 30020 chars. Then it gets truncated at 30000, meaning the last 20 chars are dropped, AND a truncation annotation is added saying "原 30020 字符". That's accurate. ### Issue 8: Looking at `build_tools_json_body` ```rust pub fn build_tools_json_body(servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)]) -> String { let entries = build_mounted_tools(servers); let mut s = String::new(); for e in &entries { s.push_str(",\n "); s.push_str(&e.schema.to_string()); } s } ``` The `String` is not preallocated. `String::new()` then `push_str` will grow. For hot paths this could matter. The expected size is `entries.len() * (avg_schema_bytes + 4)`. We could preallocate `String::with_capacity(entries.len() * avg_size)` or similar. Minor performance issue but likely material in hot paths. ### Issue 9: Looking at `clamp_fn_name` ```rust fn clamp_fn_name(name: String) -> String { const MAX: usize = 64; if name.len() <= MAX { return name; } ... let keep = MAX - suffix.len() - 1; format!("{}_{suffix}", &name[..keep]) } ``` Here `&name[..keep]` — this is byte slicing. Actually wait, the comment at the call site says: "与 config::mcp_tool_name 同款套路；输入恒 ASCII，按字节截断安全。" So it's documented. The issue is more subtle: `mcp_tool_name` returns ASCII (we verified the mapping). Then `format!("{base}_{n}")` is ASCII because `n` is a `usize`. So it's safe. In a hot path (every model loop), this means: - Lock contention on global Mutex - Multiple `String::clone()` for server_id/server_name - Schema serialization for each tool to detect oversize - JSON serialization in `to_string()` for body composition This is already in confirmed findings (issue #2). ### Issue 11: Looking at `shape_description` The function uses `t.description.as_deref()` then `map(str::trim)` then `filter(|s| !s.is_empty())`. But wait — `find_mounted` clones the entire schema `serde_json::Value` because `McpMountedTool` is cloned. This is wasteful since we only need server_id/tool_name in `execute_mcp_tool`. Then we add `_{n}` where n starts at 2. So `format!("{base}_{2}")` = up to 67 chars. That's > 64, so `clamp_fn_name` will truncate. OK. Now I have full context. The key observations: 1. `tools_json()` is a `OnceLock<String>` that returns `&'static str` via `deref`. The pointer is stable across calls because `OnceLock` only initializes once. The `.get_or_init` returns `&String` which derefs to `&str` — so `tools_json()` returns the same pointer every time. `std::ptr::eq(base, tools_json())` works because `base` is `&'static str` pointing into the `OnceLock`'s `String`. 3. `profile_tools_json(p)` returns from a *different* `OnceLock<HashMap<&'static str, String>>` cache, so subagent sessions get a different pointer. The pointer equality is correct for the current implementation, but it's fragile because: - If someone ever refactors `tools_json_for` to return `Cow<'static, str>` or wrap the result, the pointer identity would break. - If someone adds a second non-subagent code path in `tools_json_for` that returns a different string, MCP tools would either be appended incorrectly or missed. +//! MCP 外部工具挂载层（阶段 3，拍板 2A 机制 A）：连接槽 × 工具快照 → agent 工具清单。
+//!
+//! 职责（纯增量，不动内置 32 工具的任何注册路径）：
+//! - `mcp_mounted_tools()`：当前可挂载条目（函数名已消歧、schema 已整形）
+//! - `mcp_tools_json_body()`：拼进主 agent tools JSON 尾部的动态段
+//! - `find_mounted(func_name)`：阶段 4 dispatch 反查（函数名 → 服务器 id + 原始工具名）
+//!
+//! 命名：`mcp_{服务器前缀}_{工具名}`（config::mcp_tool_name，64 字节硬上限内）。
+//! 不同服务器净化后前缀相同且工具同名会撞名——`build_mounted_tools` 按构建序
+//! 加 `_2`/`_3` 序号消歧，schema 与 dispatch 反查共用同一份构建结果，不漂移。
+//!
+//! 会话边界：MCP 工具只进**主 agent** 清单（registry::tools_json_with_mcp 对
+//! 子 agent 会话短路返回白名单——设计 §5.1：子 agent 工具面静态、可枚举、可审计）。
+
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+use rmcp::model::{CallToolResult, Tool};
+use serde_json::json;
+
+use super::config::mcp_tool_name;
+use super::config::McpServerConfig;
+use super::manager::shared;
+
+/// 单个可挂载的外部工具条目（schema 与反查的单一来源）
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct McpMountedTool {
+    /// agent 看到的 function 名（消歧后）
+    pub func_name: String,
+    /// 来源服务器配置 id（挂载反查回 `config::io` 按 id 取配置 + call 路由）
+    pub server_id: String,
+    /// 来源服务器显示名（错误文案/描述兜底用，区别于 id）
+    pub server_name: String,
+    /// 服务器侧原始工具名（调用时透传）
+    pub tool_name: String,
+    /// OpenAI function schema（parameters = 服务器给的 inputSchema 原样）
+    pub schema: serde_json::Value,
+}
+
+/// 工具结果文本总长上限（fetch_url 同口径，防爆上下文）
+const MAX_RESULT_CHARS: usize = 30_000;
+
+/// 单工具 schema 序列化体积上限（字节）。B0-2（AUDIT-FIX-PLAN-2026-09-29）：
+/// inputSchema 服务器侧原样透传，无上限会每轮全量拼进 tools JSON。超限不丢
+/// 工具（保功能）：参数 schema 降级为宽松空对象，模型按描述调用、服务器侧校验兜底。
+const MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024;
+
+/// 描述整形：trim + 512 字符截断 + 缺省兜底（描述是模型选工具的主要依据，
+/// 超长服务器描述不能挤爆主上下文）
+fn shape_description(server_name: &str, t: &Tool) -> String {
+    let from_server = t
+        .description
+        .as_deref()
+        .map(str::trim)
+        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty());
+    let desc = match from_server {
+        Some(d) => d.to_string(),
+        None => format!("外部 MCP 工具（服务器：{server_name}）"),
+    };
+    desc.chars().take(512).collect()
+}
+
+/// 构建单条挂载 schema（纯函数）：parameters 用服务器 inputSchema 原样
+/// （类型上恒为 object Map；空 Map 也是合法空 schema）。
+/// B0-2：序列化超 MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES 时降级——宽松空参数 + 描述标注，不丢工具。
+fn tool_schema(server_name: &str, func_name: &str, t: &Tool) -> serde_json::Value {
+    let desc = shape_description(server_name, t);
+    let params = serde_json::Value::Object((*t.input_schema).clone());
+    let schema = json!({
+        "type": "function",
+        "function": {
+            "name": func_name,
+            "description": desc.clone(),
+            "parameters": params,
+        }
+    });
+    let oversized = serde_json::to_string(&schema)
+        .map(|s| s.len() > MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES)
+        .unwrap_or(true);
+    if oversized {
+        return json!({
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {
+                "name": func_name,
+                "description": format!("{desc}（inputSchema 过大已省略，按无固定参数调用）"),
+                "parameters": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true },
+            }
+        });
+    }
+    schema
+}
+
+/// 64 字节函数名钳制（消歧后缀可能顶破上限）：超限时尾部 8 字节换 6 位哈希。
+/// 与 config::mcp_tool_name 同款套路；输入恒 ASCII，按字节截断安全。
+fn clamp_fn_name(name: String) -> String {
+    const MAX: usize = 64;
+    if name.len() <= MAX {
+        return name;
+    }
+    use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
+    let mut h = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
+    name.hash(&mut h);
+    let suffix = format!("{:06x}", h.finish() & 0xffffff);
+    let keep = MAX - suffix.len() - 1;
+    format!("{}_{suffix}", &name[..keep])
+}
+
+/// 构建挂载条目（纯函数内核，单测直打）。函数名全局唯一：
+/// 同 base 撞名按构建序加 `_2`/`_3`；后缀撞到**真实工具名**也继续递增
+///（P2-1 评审：A 服务器有 "read" 和 "read 2"、B 服务器（同前缀）有 "read" 时，
+/// 朴素计数会产出两个 mcp_p_read_2）——used 集合查重保证 schema 无重名。
+pub fn build_mounted_tools(
+    servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)],
+) -> Vec<McpMountedTool> {
+    let mut used: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
+    let mut out = Vec::new();
+    for (server_id, server_name, tools) in servers {
+        for t in tools {
+            let base = mcp_tool_name(server_name, t.name.as_ref());
+            let mut n = 1usize;
+            let mut func = base.clone();
+            while !used.insert(func.clone()) {
+                n += 1;
+                func = clamp_fn_name(format!("{base}_{n}"));
+            }
+            out.push(McpMountedTool {
+                schema: tool_schema(server_name, &func, t),
+                func_name: func,
+                server_id: server_id.clone(),
+                server_name: server_name.clone(),
+                tool_name: t.name.to_string(),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    out
+}
+
+/// 当前可挂载条目（读全局连接槽；无连接 → 空表）
+pub fn mcp_mounted_tools() -> Vec<McpMountedTool> {
+    build_mounted_tools(&shared().mounted())
+}
+
+/// dispatch 反查（阶段 4）：函数名 → 挂载条目（拿 server_id 查配置、tool_name 调远端）。
+/// 现场重建挂载表做线性查——每轮模型循环最多 miss 一次才走到这，开销可忽略。
+pub fn find_mounted(func_name: &str) -> Option<McpMountedTool> {
+    mcp_mounted_tools().into_iter().find(|t| t.func_name == func_name)
+}
+
+// ───────────────────────── 阶段 4：dispatch 路由桥 ─────────────────────────
+
+/// dispatch 查表 miss 时的 MCP 兜底路由。
+/// 边界（全部由上游保证，此处不重复）：
+/// - 子 agent 会话到不了这里——dispatch 的白名单闸在查表前已拒（MCP 工具不在任何 profile 白名单）；
+/// - 审计由 execute_tool_impl 统一包（tool.call / tool.return 已发出）。
+/// 服务器删除/禁用/未连接都是**文本返回**（仓库惯例：不炸主循环，模型拿到
+/// 明确错误自己绕开）；只有反查不到挂载表（模型编造的工具名）走 Error 状态。
+pub(crate) async fn execute_mcp_tool(
+    app: &tauri::AppHandle,
+    name: &str,
+    args: &str,
+) -> crate::bot::registry::ToolResult {
+    let Some(mounted) = find_mounted(name) else {
+        return crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::error(
+            format!("未知工具：{name}"),
+            Vec::new(),
+        );
+    };
+    let server = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(app)
+        .mcp_servers
+        .unwrap_or_default()
+        .into_iter()
+        .find(|s| s.id == mounted.server_id);
+    match server {
+        Some(cfg) if cfg.enabled => execute_mcp_direct(&cfg, &mounted, args).await,
+        Some(_) => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
+            format!(
+                "MCP 服务器「{}」已被禁用，工具 {name} 不可用；下轮清单刷新后不再出现",
+                mounted.server_name
+            ),
+            Vec::new(),
+        ),
+        None => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
+            format!(
+                "MCP 服务器「{}」已被删除，工具 {name} 不可用；下轮清单刷新后不再出现",
+                mounted.server_name
+            ),
+            Vec::new(),
+        ),
+    }
+}
+
+/// 调用内核（无 AppHandle，单测直打）：带超时调远端 + 结果整形。
+pub(crate) async fn execute_mcp_direct(
+    cfg: &McpServerConfig,
+    mounted: &McpMountedTool,
+    args: &str,
+) -> crate::bot::registry::ToolResult {
+    let parsed: serde_json::Value =
+        serde_json::from_str(args).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
+    match shared().call_tool(cfg, &mounted.tool_name, parsed).await {
+        Ok(result) => {
+            if result.is_error == Some(true) {
+                crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
+                    format!("MCP 工具报告错误：\n{}", shape_result_text(&result)),
+                    Vec::new(),
+                )
+            } else {
+                crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::ok(shape_result_text(&result), Vec::new())
+            }
+        }
+        // 失败走 ok 文本返回（severity classifier 误判 fatal 防御，与仓库惯例一致）；
+        // 首字「MCP」非 error/warn 前缀，机械判定按 ok 处理
+        Err(e) => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::ok(
+            format!("MCP 调用失败：{e}"),
+            Vec::new(),
+        ),
+    }
+}
+
+/// CallToolResult → 模型可读文本：text 内容原样拼接，非文本块占位说明，
+/// structuredContent 附后。总长钳 MAX_RESULT_CHARS（fetch_url 同口径，防爆上下文）。
+fn shape_result_text(result: &CallToolResult) -> String {
+    let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
+    for block in &result.content {
+        match block {
+            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Text(t) => parts.push(t.text.to_string()),
+            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Image(_) => {
+                parts.push("（图片内容：本工具无法在文本回话中展示，请让用户直接查看）".into())
+            }
+            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Audio(_) => parts.push("（音频内容，略）".into()),
+            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Resource(_) | rmcp::model::ContentBlock::ResourceLink(_) => {
+                parts.push("（内嵌资源内容，略）".into())
+            }
+            // #[non_exhaustive]：协议升级新增内容类型时兜底
+            _ => parts.push("（未知内容类型，略）".into()),
+        }
+    }
+    if let Some(sc) = &result.structured_content {
+        // B0-2（AUDIT-FIX-PLAN-2026-09-29）：先序列化按上限钳制再入栈（内存优化：
+        // 超大 structuredContent 不先全量入 parts 再 join）；截断标注由下方
+        // 整段截断统一给出（sc 钳到上限后加前缀必然再触发总长钳制）
+        let mut s = sc.to_string();
+        let n = s.chars().count();
+        if n > MAX_RESULT_CHARS {
+            s = s.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect();
+        }
+        parts.push(format!("[structuredContent] {s}"));
+    }
+    let mut text = if parts.is_empty() {
+        "（工具执行完成，无返回内容）".to_string()
+    } else {
+        parts.join("\n")
+    };
+    let total = text.chars().count();
+    if total > MAX_RESULT_CHARS {
+        text = text.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect();
+        text.push_str(&format!("\n\n（内容过长已截断：原 {total} 字符）"));
+    }
+    text
+}
+
+/// 拼进主 agent tools JSON 的动态段：`",\n  {schema}..."` 序列（空表 = 空串）。
+/// registry::tools_json_with_mcp 把它插进静态 JSON 的尾部 `"\n]"` 之前。
+pub fn mcp_tools_json_body() -> String {
+    build_tools_json_body(&shared().mounted())
+}
+
+/// 同上（纯函数内核，单测直打）
+pub fn build_tools_json_body(servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)]) -> String {
+    let entries = build_mounted_tools(servers);
+    let mut s = String::new();
+    for e in &entries {
+        s.push_str(",\n  ");
+        s.push_str(&e.schema.to_string());
+    }
+    s
+}

Good, so `TOOLS_TABLE` has 34 entries (32 main-visible + 2 subagent-only), and `tools_json()` returns 32 entries. The test `tools_json_with_mcp_assembly_contract` hard-codes "32" and "33" which couples to the current count. Now I have all the context I need to provide my review. Let me summarize my findings and submit the review comments. Key issues identified: 1. **medium**: `std::ptr::eq(base, tools_json())` - pointer equality to detect subagent return is fragile. It relies on `tools_json_for` returning the exact pointer from `tools_json()`'s `OnceLock` for the main session. If `tools_json_for` is ever refactored to return `Cow<'static, str>` or add another code path, the pointer identity would silently break and MCP tools would either be incorrectly mounted into subagent sessions or missed from the main session. 2. **medium**: Hot path rebuilds JSON without caching. `run_model_loop_core` runs `for round in 0..max_rounds` (up to 50 rounds), and each round calls `tools_json_with_mcp()` which allocates a new String and rebuilds the full JSON. When MCP tools are connected and the tool set is relatively stable, this is wasted allocation/copying. 3. **medium**: The assembly trusts that `mount::mcp_tools_json_body()` returns a body that keeps the outer JSON well-formed, but there's no check that `body` itself is valid JSON. While `build_tools_json_body` uses `serde_json::Value::to_string()` on a `json!()` value (which is always valid), there's no runtime validation at the splice boundary. 4. **low**: The test `tools_json_with_mcp_assembly_contract` hard-codes "32" and "33" which couples the test to the current count of built-in tools. If the count changes (e.g., a new tool is added), the test fails for an incidental reason. 5. **low**: The test `tools_json_with_mcp_assembly_contract` re-implements the splice logic inline instead of calling `splice_mcp_body` directly. This means a bug in `splice_mcp_body` would not be caught by this test. Now let me submit the review comments:

46|
47|/// 描述整形：trim + 512 字符截断 + 缺省兜底（描述是模型选工具的主要依据，
48|/// 超长服务器描述不能挤爆主上下文）
49|fn shape_description(server_name: &str, t: &Tool) -> String {
50|    let from_server = t
51|        .description
52|        .as_deref()
53|        .map(str::trim)
54|        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty());
55|    let desc = match from_server {
56|        Some(d) => d.to_string(),
57|        None => format!("外部 MCP 工具（服务器：{server_name}）"),
58|    };
59|    desc.chars().take(512).collect()
60|}
61|
62|/// 构建单条挂载 schema（纯函数）：parameters 用服务器 inputSchema 原样
63|/// （类型上恒为 object Map；空 Map 也是合法空 schema）。
64|/// B0-2：序列化超 MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES 时降级——宽松空参数 + 描述标注，不丢工具。
65|fn tool_schema(server_name: &str, func_name: &str, t: &Tool) -> serde_json::Value {
66|    let desc = shape_description(server_name, t);
67|    let params = serde_json::Value::Object((*t.input_schema).clone());
68|    let schema = json!({
69|        "type": "function",
70|        "function": {
71|            "name": func_name,
72|            "description": desc.clone(),
73|            "parameters": params,
74|        }
75|    });
76|    let oversized = serde_json::to_string(&schema)
77|        .map(|s| s.len() > MAX_SCHEMA_BYTES)
78|        .unwrap_or(true);
79|    if oversized {
80|        return json!({
81|            "type": "function",
82|            "function": {
83|                "name": func_name,
84|                "description": format!("{desc}（inputSchema 过大已省略，按无固定参数调用）"),
85|                "parameters": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true },
86|            }
87|        });
88|    }
89|    schema
90|}
91|
92|/// 64 字节函数名钳制（消歧后缀可能顶破上限）：超限时尾部 8 字节换 6 位哈希。
93|/// 与 config::mcp_tool_name 同款套路；输入恒 ASCII，按字节截断安全。
94|fn clamp_fn_name(name: String) -> String {
95|    const MAX: usize = 64;
96|    if name.len() <= MAX {
97|        return name;
98|    }
99|    use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
100|    let mut h = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
101|    name.hash(&mut h);
102|    let suffix = format!("{:06x}", h.finish() & 0xffffff);
103|    let keep = MAX - suffix.len() - 1;
104|    format!("{}_{suffix}", &name[..keep])
105|}
106|
107|/// 构建挂载条目（纯函数内核，单测直打）。函数名全局唯一：
108|/// 同 base 撞名按构建序加 `_2`/`_3`；后缀撞到**真实工具名**也继续递增
109|///（P2-1 评审：A 服务器有 "read" 和 "read 2"、B 服务器（同前缀）有 "read" 时，
110|/// 朴素计数会产出两个 mcp_p_read_2）——used 集合查重保证 schema 无重名。
111|pub fn build_mounted_tools(
112|    servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)],
113|) -> Vec<McpMountedTool> {
114|    let mut used: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
115|    let mut out = Vec::new();
116|    for (server_id, server_name, tools) in servers {
117|        for t in tools {
118|            let base = mcp_tool_name(server_name, t.name.as_ref());
119|            let mut n = 1usize;
120|            let mut func = base.clone();
121|            while !used.insert(func.clone()) {
122|                n += 1;
123|                func = clamp_fn_name(format!("{base}_{n}"));
124|            }
125|            out.push(McpMountedTool {
126|                schema: tool_schema(server_name, &func, t),
127|                func_name: func,
128|                server_id: server_id.clone(),
129|                server_name: server_name.clone(),
130|                tool_name: t.name.to_string(),
131|            });
132|        }
133|    }
134|    out
135|}
136|
137|/// 当前可挂载条目（读全局连接槽；无连接 → 空表）
138|pub fn mcp_mounted_tools() -> Vec<McpMountedTool> {
139|    build_mounted_tools(&shared().mounted())
140|}
141|
142|/// dispatch 反查（阶段 4）：函数名 → 挂载条目（拿 server_id 查配置、tool_name 调远端）。
143|/// 现场重建挂载表做线性查——每轮模型循环最多 miss 一次才走到这，开销可忽略。
144|pub fn find_mounted(func_name: &str) -> Option<McpMountedTool> {
145|    mcp_mounted_tools().into_iter().find(|t| t.func_name == func_name)
146|}
147|
148|// ───────────────────────── 阶段 4：dispatch 路由桥 ─────────────────────────
149|
150|/// dispatch 查表 miss 时的 MCP 兜底路由。
151|/// 边界（全部由上游保证，此处不重复）：
152|/// - 子 agent 会话到不了这里——dispatch 的白名单闸在查表前已拒（MCP 工具不在任何 profile 白名单）；
153|/// - 审计由 execute_tool_impl 统一包（tool.call / tool.return 已发出）。
154|/// 服务器删除/禁用/未连接都是**文本返回**（仓库惯例：不炸主循环，模型拿到
155|/// 明确错误自己绕开）；只有反查不到挂载表（模型编造的工具名）走 Error 状态。
156|pub(crate) async fn execute_mcp_tool(
157|    app: &tauri::AppHandle,
158|    name: &str,
159|    args: &str,
160|) -> crate::bot::registry::ToolResult {
161|    let Some(mounted) = find_mounted(name) else {
162|        return crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::error(
163|            format!("未知工具：{name}"),
164|            Vec::new(),
165|        );
166|    };
167|    let server = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(app)
168|        .mcp_servers
169|        .unwrap_or_default()
170|        .into_iter()
171|        .find(|s| s.id == mounted.server_id);
172|    match server {
173|        Some(cfg) if cfg.enabled => execute_mcp_direct(&cfg, &mounted, args).await,
174|        Some(_) => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
175|            format!(
176|                "MCP 服务器「{}」已被禁用，工具 {name} 不可用；下轮清单刷新后不再出现",
177|                mounted.server_name
178|            ),
179|            Vec::new(),
180|        ),
181|        None => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
182|            format!(
183|                "MCP 服务器「{}」已被删除，工具 {name} 不可用；下轮清单刷新后不再出现",
184|                mounted.server_name
185|            ),
186|            Vec::new(),
187|        ),
188|    }
189|}
190|
191|/// 调用内核（无 AppHandle，单测直打）：带超时调远端 + 结果整形。
192|pub(crate) async fn execute_mcp_direct(
193|    cfg: &McpServerConfig,
194|    mounted: &McpMountedTool,
195|    args: &str,
196|) -> crate::bot::registry::ToolResult {
197|    let parsed: serde_json::Value =
198|        serde_json::from_str(args).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
199|    match shared().call_tool(cfg, &mounted.tool_name, parsed).await {
200|        Ok(result) => {
201|            if result.is_error == Some(true) {
202|                crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::warn(
203|                    format!("MCP 工具报告错误：\n{}", shape_result_text(&result)),
204|                    Vec::new(),
205|                )
206|            } else {
207|                crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::ok(shape_result_text(&result), Vec::new())
208|            }
209|        }
210|        // 失败走 ok 文本返回（severity classifier 误判 fatal 防御，与仓库惯例一致）；
211|        // 首字「MCP」非 error/warn 前缀，机械判定按 ok 处理
212|        Err(e) => crate::bot::registry::ToolResult::ok(
213|            format!("MCP 调用失败：{e}"),
214|            Vec::new(),
215|        ),
216|    }
217|}
218|
219|/// CallToolResult → 模型可读文本：text 内容原样拼接，非文本块占位说明，
220|/// structuredContent 附后。总长钳 MAX_RESULT_CHARS（fetch_url 同口径，防爆上下文）。
221|fn shape_result_text(result: &CallToolResult) -> String {
222|    let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
223|    for block in &result.content {
224|        match block {
225|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Text(t) => parts.push(t.text.to_string()),
226|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Image(_) => {
227|                parts.push("（图片内容：本工具无法在文本回话中展示，请让用户直接查看）".into())
228|            }
229|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Audio(_) => parts.push("（音频内容，略）".into()),
230|            rmcp::model::ContentBlock::Resource(_) | rmcp::model::ContentBlock::ResourceLink(_) => {
231|                parts.push("（内嵌资源内容，略）".into())
232|            }
233|            // #[non_exhaustive]：协议升级新增内容类型时兜底
234|            _ => parts.push("（未知内容类型，略）".into()),
235|        }
236|    }
237|    if let Some(sc) = &result.structured_content {
238|        // B0-2（AUDIT-FIX-PLAN-2026-09-29）：先序列化按上限钳制再入栈（内存优化：
239|        // 超大 structuredContent 不先全量入 parts 再 join）；截断标注由下方
240|        // 整段截断统一给出（sc 钳到上限后加前缀必然再触发总长钳制）
241|        let mut s = sc.to_string();
242|        let n = s.chars().count();
243|        if n > MAX_RESULT_CHARS {
244|            s = s.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect();
245|        }
246|        parts.push(format!("[structuredContent] {s}"));
247|    }
248|    let mut text = if parts.is_empty() {
249|        "（工具执行完成，无返回内容）".to_string()
250|    } else {
251|        parts.join("\n")
252|    };
253|    let total = text.chars().count();
254|    if total > MAX_RESULT_CHARS {
255|        text = text.chars().take(MAX_RESULT_CHARS).collect();
256|        text.push_str(&format!("\n\n（内容过长已截断：原 {total} 字符）"));
257|    }
258|    text
259|}
260|
261|/// 拼进主 agent tools JSON 的动态段：`",\n  {schema}..."` 序列（空表 = 空串）。
262|/// registry::tools_json_with_mcp 把它插进静态 JSON 的尾部 `"\n]"` 之前。
263|pub fn mcp_tools_json_body() -> String {
264|    build_tools_json_body(&shared().mounted())
265|}
266|
267|/// 同上（纯函数内核，单测直打）
268|pub fn build_tools_json_body(servers: &[(String, String, Vec<Tool>)]) -> String {
269|    let entries = build_mounted_tools(servers);
270|    let mut s = String::new();
271|    for e in &entries {
272|        s.push_str(",\n  ");
273|        s.push_str(&e.schema.to_string());
274|    }
275|    s
276|}

325|        // 朴素计数会给 B 产出 mcp_p_read_2 —— 与 A 的真实 read_2 重名。

Hot-path rebuild on every model loop round 3. No symmetric check on body 4. Hardcoded `33` count 5. Test re-implements splice logic inline Let me look for more issues. Let me look more carefully at the test code and at the actual function: Looking at `tools_json_with_mcp`: - The function uses `CONTRACT_WARNED.set(()).is_ok()` pattern - which means warning fires only once. But this also means in production, if the contract is broken, no warning is fired after the first one. This could mask ongoing issues. - The `static CONTRACT_WARNED: std::sync::OnceLock<()> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();` is inside the function body - this means it's a new static each time the function is called. Actually, in Rust, a `static` declared inside a function body is actually a static item that gets initialized once - this is the standard pattern. Wait - there's a subtle issue. The CONTRACT_WARNED static is inside the function body, but Rust creates the static once (as a single item) regardless of how many times the function is called. That's correct. Let me check what happens if the contract is broken: `splice_mcp_body` returns `Cow::Borrowed(base)` (i.e., no MCP tools mounted that round). But the warning fires only once via `CONTRACT_WARNED.set(()).is_ok()`. If the contract is permanently broken, all subsequent calls silently fall back. This might be intentional but worth noting. Now I have a complete picture. Let me analyze any additional real issues: Looking carefully at the new `tools_json_with_mcp` function: 1. **The warning pattern is one-shot forever, not per-process-restart-by-condition**: The `CONTRACT_WARNED` OnceLock fires the warning only ONCE in the lifetime of the process. After the first warning, subsequent contract breaks are silently swallowed (just falling back to base). This means a "permanent contract break" condition would only warn once. 2. **Concerning issue**: The "Contract broke" detection in `tools_json_with_mcp` (line 963) checks `!base.ends_with("\n]")` and warns but STILL calls `splice_mcp_body(base, &body)`. Then `splice_mcp_body` checks the SAME condition (`base.strip_suffix("\n]")`) and falls back. So the contract check is duplicated - one in the outer function (with warning), one inside `splice_mcp_body` (silent fallback). The double check is a minor smell but not a bug. 3. **A real issue worth flagging**: Looking at the test `tools_json_with_mcp_without_connections_is_borrowed_static` - the test takes `SHARED_MCP_TEST_LOCK.blocking_lock()` first, but `tools_json_with_mcp(None)` is called AFTER `shutdown()`. This test does NOT actually verify the contract when no connections exist - it would still work because `mcp_tools_json_body()` returns empty, leading to `Cow::Borrowed`. But if connections were leftover somehow, the test would not catch it. The test design is correct (B0-3 protection). Let me look for one more potential issue. Let me also check the function's interaction with the audit system. The function is called inside `run_model_loop_core` and the consumer (line 546-558) handles parse failure with audit. So the audit is fine. **One real issue I see**: Looking at the warning logic, the `CONTRACT_WARNED.set(()).is_ok()` checks if `set` returned `Ok` (i.e., this is the first time). The warning only fires ONCE in the entire process lifetime. After that, even if the contract remains broken, the system silently falls back to base. This means a persistent contract break will produce only one warning and then silently degrade. The user will see MCP tools disappear with only one log line as evidence. This is a legitimate issue worth flagging - the "fire once" pattern can mask ongoing problems, especially since this is in a hot path that runs up to 50 rounds per session. 1|# 子 Agent 编排系统设计（方案 B 定稿）— 2026-09-27

Looking at the test code: **Issue: `static CONTRACT_WARNED` inside function body** - This is valid Rust, but I want to make sure. Let me check the Rust documentation: Yes, this is valid Rust - declaring `static X: T = ...` inside a function body creates a single static item that lives for the entire program lifetime. This is a well-known Rust idiom (similar to `static FOO: OnceLock<X> = OnceLock::new()` at the module level). Now let me also think about whether there's a real concern with `mcp_tools_json_body()` being called when contract is broken. Looking at the function: ```rust let body = crate::bot::mcp::mount::mcp_tools_json_body(); if body.is_empty() { return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(base); } ``` Even if the contract is broken, the body is still computed (calls `shared().mounted()`, etc.). This is wasted work, but not a correctness issue. Let me now finalize my review. I want to also check whether the `_serial` variable scope issue. In `tools_json_with_mcp_without_connections_is_borrowed_static`: ```rust let _serial = crate::bot::mcp::manager::SHARED_MCP_TEST_LOCK.blocking_lock(); let _ = tauri::async_runtime::block_on(crate::bot::mcp::manager::shared().shutdown()); let with = tools_json_with_mcp(None); ``` The `_serial` is held throughout the test. The `_` in `let _ = ...` swallows the `Result` from `shutdown()`. This is intentional - we don't care about shutdown errors in tests. Good. Now, one issue I want to flag is the **inconsistent test coverage**: The test for `tools_json_with_mcp_without_connections_is_borrowed_static` calls `tools_json_with_mcp(None)` and `tools_json_with_mcp(Some("not-a-subagent-session"))`. The previously confirmed findings (5 issues related to pointer equality detection, hot-path rebuild, body validation, hardcoded count, and inline splice reimplementation) were noted and I focused on finding other real issues. I identified and reported the following additional issues (all flagged via `code_comment`): 1. **One-shot warning masks persistent contract break (medium)** — `CONTRACT_WARNED` `OnceLock` only fires once per process. Persistent contract break = silent fallback forever after the first log line. Proposed rate-limited reminder pattern. 2. **Test gap: no direct test for contract-warning path (low)** — `splice_mcp_body_falls_back_when_base_contract_broken` only exercises the inner helper. Two layers doing the same invariant check. 4. **Wasted body computation on contract break (low)** — `mcp_tools_json_body()` (which traverses the global connection slot) is called unconditionally even when the contract is broken and the result will be discarded. Suggest moving the contract check before the body computation so a persistent contract break doesn't pay the mount-rebuild cost on every model-loop round (up to 50/session) for nothing.

I now have a complete picture. Let me analyze the change against the checklist: **Analysis Summary** This change replaces `unwrap()` (which would panic if JSON parsing failed) with a fail-soft approach: on parse failure, log to audit and use an empty tool list `[]`. The change is in `run_model_loop_core`, the hot path of the model loop. Key considerations: 1. **Error Handling**: This is actually an improvement over `unwrap()` — it removes a panic point in production. This is good practice. 2. **Subtle Concern with Empty Tools `[]`**: When the JSON parse fails, the code falls back to `serde_json::json!([])`. This is an empty array. Let me think about whether this is consistent with how the LLM API expects the `tools` field. Some APIs may expect either no `tools` field, or a non-empty list, or an empty list — but since the original code was always providing a parsed list, providing an empty array should be safer than omitting. 3. **Potential Issue - Tools Field Usage**: When tools is `[]`, what does the LLM API do? This depends on the protocol. Let me check if this could cause issues. Let me look further down to see how `tools` is used in the loop:

OK. The `tools` field in the request body is being passed as the parsed `serde_json::Value`. The Anthropic branch handles `[]` correctly (omits the field). The OpenAI branch always includes it as `[]`. OpenAI's API typically allows empty `tools: []` (no functions), though some implementations might. Now let me think about the overall change once more: The change is clearly an **improvement** over `unwrap()` since: 1. It removes a panic in the model loop hot path 2. The audit callback is appropriate for reporting the issue 3. Falling back to empty tools is a reasonable degraded state — the model will respond with text instead of tools However, there are a few minor concerns: 1. **No way to break out of loop**: The audit is just logged but the loop continues. If the parse keeps failing every round (e.g., a persistent corruption), each round logs an audit event — this could spam. The code is at the top of `run_model_loop_core`, outside the round loop, so it actually only fires once per `run_model_loop_core` invocation. Let me check:

The OpenAI branch always sets `"tools": tools` regardless. For OpenAI API, `tools: []` should be valid (no functions to call), though some providers may treat it differently. The Anthropic branch handles empty tools correctly (omits field). However, there's a subtle issue: if the JSON parse fails, falling back to `[]` means the model will respond with text-only output, but the user's expectation is that tools work. This is correct. 3. **No re-attempt in same loop**: If parse fails once at the top of the loop, every round of the loop will use the same `[]` because `tools` is parsed once outside the loop. This means even if MCP configuration gets fixed mid-loop, this round won't recover. 123|/// 轮询执行注册表直到排空（StopGuard Drop 注销，归零 = 全部收尾完）或超时
124|fn wait_executions_drained<R: tauri::Runtime>(
125|    app: &tauri::AppHandle<R>,
126|    grace: std::time::Duration,
127|) -> bool {
128|    let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + grace;
129|    loop {
130|        if bot_slash::active_execution_count(app) == 0 {
131|            return true;
132|        }
133|        if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
134|            return false;
135|        }
136|        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
137|    }

1|//! MCP 连接生命周期管理（阶段 2）：连 / 断 / 指纹对齐重载 / 懒重连。
2|//!
3|//! 托管形态：进程级 `OnceLock` 单例（`shared()`），lib.rs setup 触发
4|//! 启动重载；命令、registry 挂载层、退出清理全部经 `shared()` 访问。
5|//!
6|//! 隔离模型（拍板 4A）：
7|//! - stdio 服务器 = 独立子进程，崩溃不伤宿主（传输断开 → 槽位转 Down）；
8|//! - 懒重连：Down 不是终点——下次 `ensure_connected`（工具调用前 / 全量重载）
9|//!   会重新拉起进程；连接失败把错误写进槽位 + 审计，绝不 panic / 不阻塞其他服务器；
10|//! - 所有 await 都在锁外：std Mutex 只护 map 增删查（临界区内无 IO / 无 await），
11|//!   调用前把 `Arc<RunningService>` 克隆出来。
12|//!
13|//! 授权边界（安全不变式）：`spawn_service` 运行的程序只能来自
14|//! bot-config.json 的 `mcpServers[].command`，唯一写入路径是设置页确认弹窗后的
15|//! `mcp_server_save`，模型侧无任何触达该配置的工具。程序名经
16|//! `STDIO_LAUNCH_ALLOWLIST` 白名单 + 逐臂字面量构造——不存在「变量 → 进程名」
17|//! 数据流（Mimosa 命令注入闸），不走 shell、无字符串拼接执行。
18|//!
19|//! rmcp API 备忘（3.5.0，写死防漂移）：
20|//! - 客户端服务：`().into_dyn().serve(transport)` → `RunningService<RoleClient, Box<dyn DynService<RoleClient>>>`
21|//!   （DynService: Send + Sync，官方注释「store the services in a collection」即此用法）
22|//! - `RunningService` Deref 到 `Peer<RoleClient>`：`list_all_tools()` / `call_tool_once()`
23|//! - 关闭：持有 `cancellation_token()` clone，`cancel()` 触发优雅退出；
24|//!   子进程由 `TokioChildProcess` 的 Drop 兜底 kill（`ChildWithCleanup`）

1|//! MCP 服务器配置的 tauri 命令（3 个，设置页 McpPanel 用）。
2|//!
3|//! - `mcp_server_save`：新增/编辑（id 为空由后端生成 uuid；校验失败响亮报错）
4|//! - `mcp_server_delete`：按 id 删除（幂等）
5|//! - `mcp_server_toggle`：启停窄口径更新（只动 enabled，避免前端旧快照整份覆盖）
6|//!
7|//! 三个命令都返回更新后的完整列表（前端免二次读取）。
8|//! 写路径与 add_allowed_dir 同款：CONFIG_WRITE_LOCK 全程持锁 RMW
9|//!（update_config_file 的闭包不返 Result，携带校验错误的 save 走本模块

28|/// 失败只记审计不回滚配置——连接态不是配置的真相源）。
29|fn trigger_reload(app: &AppHandle) {
30|    let app = app.clone();
31|    tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
32|        shared().reload_from_config(&app).await;
33|    });

37|/// 返回 f 的结果（f 可从 &mut BotConfig 提取需要的值带出来）。
38|fn with_locked_config<T>(
39|    app: &AppHandle,
40|    f: impl FnOnce(&mut BotConfig) -> CommandResult<T>,
41|) -> CommandResult<T> {
42|    let _g = crate::bot::config::io::lock_config_write();

46|    crate::bot::config::io::write_bot_config_file_locked(&crate::db::data_dir(app), cfg)?;
47|    Ok(out)

69|/// 返回保存后的完整列表。
70|#[tauri::command]
71|pub fn mcp_server_save(
72|    app: AppHandle,
73|    server: McpServerConfig,
74|) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpServerConfig>> {

81|        let saved = cfg

83|            .as_ref()
84|            .and_then(|l| l.iter().find(|s| s.id == server.id))
85|            .cloned();

88|    if let Some(s) = &saved {
89|        audit(&app, "mcp.server_saved", s);
90|    }
91|    trigger_reload(&app);
92|    Ok(list)

161|/// 设置页读 MCP 状态：配置全量（含禁用）× 连接槽位合并。
162|/// 同步命令：只做内存合并（槽位是 std Mutex 短临界区），不触发连接。
163|#[tauri::command]
164|pub fn mcp_status(app: AppHandle) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpServerStatus>> {
165|    let cfg = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(&app);
166|    let manager = shared();
167|    let mut out = Vec::new();

171|            (st.state, st.error, st.tool_count)
172|        };
173|        let transport = s.transport_kind().as_str().to_string();
174|        out.push(McpServerStatus {
175|            id: s.id,
176|            name: s.name,
177|            transport,
178|            enabled: s.enabled,
179|            state,
180|            error,
181|            tool_count,
182|        });
183|    }
184|    Ok(out)

123|/// 轮询执行注册表直到排空（StopGuard Drop 注销，归零 = 全部收尾完）或超时
124|fn wait_executions_drained<R: tauri::Runtime>(
125|    app: &tauri::AppHandle<R>,
126|    grace: std::time::Duration,
127|) -> bool {
128|    let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + grace;

130|        if bot_slash::active_execution_count(app) == 0 {
131|            return true;
132|        }
133|        if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
134|            return false;
135|        }

OK, so `block_on` with `shutdown()` is already used in the codebase for tests. Now let me think about whether the `block_on` in cleanup_on_exit_with is actually problematic. Looking at `shutdown()`: ```rust pub async fn shutdown(&self) { let slots: Vec<Slot> = self.slots().drain().map(|(_, v)| v).collect(); for slot in slots { Self::close_old(Some(slot)).await; } } ``` The only await point is `Self::close_old`. Inside close_old: ```rust async fn close_old(slot: Option<Slot>) { if let Some(Slot::Connected { service, .. }) = slot { service.cancellation_token().cancel(); } } ``` The only operation is calling `cancel()` on a cancellation token. This is synchronous. So the future returned by `close_old` should immediately complete without waiting on anything else. This means the `block_on` should not deadlock. However, there's still a concern: `tauri::async_runtime::block_on` blocks the current thread, and in the cleanup_on_exit context, this is called from the Tauri `RunEvent::ExitRequested` callback handler. Calling `block_on` on the tauri runtime from a sync context managed by tauri could potentially be problematic. Let me verify this is safe by looking at the Tauri docs. Actually, since `tauri::async_runtime` uses tokio underneath, calling `block_on` on the tokio handle should generally work as long as we're not on the same thread as a tokio worker. The cleanup callback is invoked from the main thread, not from a tokio worker, so this should be safe. diff --git a/src-tauri/src/bot/mcp/commands.rs b/src-tauri/src/bot/mcp/commands.rs

+//! MCP 服务器配置的 tauri 命令（3 个，设置页 McpPanel 用）。
+//!
+//! - `mcp_server_save`：新增/编辑（id 为空由后端生成 uuid；校验失败响亮报错）
+//! - `mcp_server_delete`：按 id 删除（幂等）
+//! - `mcp_server_toggle`：启停窄口径更新（只动 enabled，避免前端旧快照整份覆盖）
+//!
+//! 三个命令都返回更新后的完整列表（前端免二次读取）。
+//! 写路径与 add_allowed_dir 同款：CONFIG_WRITE_LOCK 全程持锁 RMW
+//!（update_config_file 的闭包不返 Result，携带校验错误的 save 走本模块
+//! with_locked_config 展开）；审计在放锁后写（锁内不夹审计 IO，同仓惯例）。
+//!
+//! 权限模型（拍板 3A）：显式确认在前端——添加/启用前 McpPanel 完整展示
+//! 将运行的命令行/参数/env，用户确认才发起 save；后端负责校验 + 审计留痕。
+//! 阶段 2 起 save/delete/toggle 成功后触发 mcp manager 重载连接。
+
+use tauri::AppHandle;
+
+use crate::bot::BotConfig;
+use crate::error::CommandResult;
+
+use super::config::{
+    normalize_server, remove_from_config, set_enabled_in_config, upsert_in_config,
+    McpServerConfig,
+};
+use super::manager::shared;
+
+/// 配置变更后触发连接重载（fire-and-forget：写盘已原子完成，重载自行读盘对齐；
+/// 失败只记审计不回滚配置——连接态不是配置的真相源）。
+fn trigger_reload(app: &AppHandle) {
+    let app = app.clone();
+    tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
+        shared().reload_from_config(&app).await;
+    });
+}
+
+/// 持锁 RMW 内核：锁内 迁移 → 读 → f（可失败，失败不落盘）→ 原子写。
+/// 返回 f 的结果（f 可从 &mut BotConfig 提取需要的值带出来）。
+fn with_locked_config<T>(
+    app: &AppHandle,
+    f: impl FnOnce(&mut BotConfig) -> CommandResult<T>,
+) -> CommandResult<T> {
+    let _g = crate::bot::config::io::lock_config_write();
+    let _ = crate::bot::config::schema::migrate_bot_config_schema_locked(app);
+    let mut cfg = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(app);
+    let out = f(&mut cfg)?;
+    crate::bot::config::io::write_bot_config_file_locked(&crate::db::data_dir(app), cfg)?;
+    Ok(out)
+}
+
+fn list_of(cfg: &BotConfig) -> Vec<McpServerConfig> {
+    cfg.mcp_servers.clone().unwrap_or_default()
+}
+
+fn audit(app: &AppHandle, event: &str, server: &McpServerConfig) {
+    crate::bot::audit_log(
+        app,
+        &format!(
+            "{event} | id: {} | name: {} | transport: {} | enabled: {}",
+            // id 来自前端（P2-2 评审）：free-form 审计行按字符转义防伪造日志行
+            crate::bot::escape_for_log(&server.id, 64),
+            crate::bot::escape_for_log(&server.name, 50),
+            server.transport_kind().as_str(),
+            server.enabled,
+        ),
+    );
+}
+
+/// 新增或编辑 MCP 服务器。id 为空 = 新建（后端生成 uuid）；非空 = 按 id 整体替换。
+/// 返回保存后的完整列表。
+#[tauri::command]
+pub fn mcp_server_save(
+    app: AppHandle,
+    server: McpServerConfig,
+) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpServerConfig>> {
+    let mut server = normalize_server(server);
+    if server.id.trim().is_empty() {
+        server.id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple().to_string();
+    }
+    let (list, saved) = with_locked_config(&app, |cfg| {
+        upsert_in_config(cfg, server.clone())?;
+        let saved = cfg
+            .mcp_servers
+            .as_ref()
+            .and_then(|l| l.iter().find(|s| s.id == server.id))
+            .cloned();
+        Ok((list_of(cfg), saved))
+    })?;
+    if let Some(s) = &saved {
+        audit(&app, "mcp.server_saved", s);
+    }
+    trigger_reload(&app);
+    Ok(list)
+}
+
+/// 按 id 删除 MCP 服务器（幂等：不存在不报错）。返回删除后的完整列表。
+#[tauri::command]
+pub fn mcp_server_delete(app: AppHandle, id: String) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpServerConfig>> {
+    let (list, removed) = with_locked_config(&app, |cfg| {
+        let removed = cfg
+            .mcp_servers
+            .as_ref()
+            .and_then(|l| l.iter().find(|s| s.id == id))
+            .cloned();
+        remove_from_config(cfg, &id);
+        Ok((list_of(cfg), removed))
+    })?;
+    if let Some(s) = &removed {
+        audit(&app, "mcp.server_deleted", s);
+    }
+    trigger_reload(&app);
+    Ok(list)
+}
+
+/// 启停 MCP 服务器（窄口径：只动 enabled 字段）。返回更新后的完整列表。
+#[tauri::command]
+pub fn mcp_server_toggle(
+    app: AppHandle,
+    id: String,
+    enabled: bool,
+) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpServerConfig>> {
+    let (list, toggled) = with_locked_config(&app, |cfg| {
+        let ok = set_enabled_in_config(cfg, &id, enabled);
+        let toggled = if ok {
+            cfg.mcp_servers
+                .as_ref()
+                .and_then(|l| l.iter().find(|s| s.id == id))
+                .cloned()
+        } else {
+            None
+        };
+        Ok((list_of(cfg), toggled))
+    })?;
+    if let Some(s) = &toggled {
+        audit(&app, "mcp.server_toggled", s);
+    }
+    trigger_reload(&app);
+    Ok(list)
+}
+
+/// MCP 服务器状态（mcp_status 命令返回）：配置 + 连接槽合并视图
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct McpServerStatus {
+    pub id: String,
+    pub name: String,
+    pub transport: String,
+    pub enabled: bool,
+    /// "connected" | "down" | "absent"（absent = 未启用或尚未轮到连接）
+    pub state: String,
+    pub error: Option<String>,
+    pub tool_count: usize,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct McpToolBrief {
+    pub name: String,
+    pub description: Option<String>,
+}
+
+/// 设置页读 MCP 状态：配置全量（含禁用）× 连接槽位合并。
+/// 同步命令：只做内存合并（槽位是 std Mutex 短临界区），不触发连接。
+#[tauri::command]
+pub fn mcp_status(app: AppHandle) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpServerStatus>> {
+    let cfg = crate::bot::config::io::load_config(&app);
+    let manager = shared();
+    let mut out = Vec::new();
+    for s in cfg.mcp_servers.unwrap_or_default() {
+        let (state, error, tool_count) = {
+            let st = manager.status_of(&s.id);
+            (st.state, st.error, st.tool_count)
+        };
+        let transport = s.transport_kind().as_str().to_string();
+        out.push(McpServerStatus {
+            id: s.id,
+            name: s.name,
+            transport,
+            enabled: s.enabled,
+            state,
+            error,
+            tool_count,
+        });
+    }
+    Ok(out)
+}
+
+/// 单服务器已发现工具清单（设置页「查看工具」展开用）：只读连接槽的缓存快照，
+/// 不触发连接（未连接 → 空列表）。
+#[tauri::command]
+pub fn mcp_server_tools(app: AppHandle, id: String) -> CommandResult<Vec<McpToolBrief>> {
+    Ok(shared()
+        .tools_of(&id)
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|t| McpToolBrief {
+            name: t.name.to_string(),
+            description: t.description.as_ref().map(|d| d.to_string()),
+        })
+        .collect())
+}

Now let me provide a final summary of the review. ## Summary `McpPanel.tsx` is a new 611-line React component for managing MCP (Model Context Protocol) external tool servers in the settings page — server list with status dots, add/edit form, a pre-save confirmation dialog that fully renders the command/URL/env to be executed, a tool-browser panel, and event-driven status refresh. The overall design is sound (defensive coding, `useCallback` for stable references, manual cleanup of `setTimeout` refs, async/await style). ### Issues raised (8 total, attached as code comments) **Medium (5):** 1. **`expandTools` async race** — clicking between servers quickly can show tools from a previous server under a different server (backend `mcp_server_tools` has no cancellation support, confirmed via commands.rs). 2. **Duplicate parsing logic** — `parseEnvLines` and `parseHeaderLines` are near-identical; extract a shared `parseKeyValueLines(text, sep)` helper. 3. **`startEdit` inconsistent async style** — lone `.then().catch()` chain in a file that otherwise uniformly uses `async/await`. 4. **Dead branch `if (!form.command)`** — `form.command` is a select sourced from `MCP_STDIO_LAUNCHERS` (10-entry readonly tuple in types.ts), so the guard is provably unreachable. 5. **`refreshTimers` accumulation** — pushed handles never removed until unmount; collapse to a single resettable timer. **Low (3):** 6. Unlisten cleanup `un.then((f) => f())` swallows errors. 7. `window.confirm()` for delete is inconsistent with the custom save modal. 8. Magic numbers (3000/800/80/5/600/8) should be hoisted to named constants. ### Items intentionally not flagged - **Env plaintext in confirmation dialog**: explicitly intentional per the "拍板 3A" design comment — the dialog's purpose is to surface what's about to run; the label `明文存本机配置文件` makes this transparent. - **XSS**: all user-controlled values are rendered through React's auto-escaping. - **`un.then` not awaited in cleanup**: standard Tauri pattern; only added a `.catch` mirror.

158|/**
159| * 把 invoke 抛出的 unknown 格式化成 user-friendly 文本（任意类型都能转）：
160| * - CommandError → message
161| * - Error → message
162| * - 字符串 → 自身
163| * - 其他对象 → JSON.stringify
164| * - null / undefined → ""
165| */
166|export function formatCommandError(e: unknown): string {
167|  if (e == null) return "";
168|  if (isCommandError(e)) return e.message;
169|  if (e instanceof Error) return e.message || e.name || "未知错误";
170|  if (typeof e === "string") return e;
171|  try {
172|    return JSON.stringify(e);
173|  } catch {
174|    return String(e);
175|  }
176|}
177|
178|export interface HandleOptions {
179|  /**
180|   * 不弹 alert，仅写 console。
181|   * 用于已有 inline 错误 UI 的位置（如 SettingsPage 面板 setError），
182|   * 避免双重提示。
183|   * 默认 false（弹 alert 提示用户）。
184|   */
185|  silent?: boolean;
186|  /**
187|   * 重试回调：仅当错误 recoverable === true 时生效——
188|   * 弹 confirm 询问「是否重试」，用户确认后调用本回调重新执行失败的操作。
189|   * recoverable === false（或调用方未传）时走普通 alert，不调用本回调。
190|   */
191|  onRetry?: () => void;
192|}
193|
194|/**
195| * 统一错误处理入口。CommandError → console 打 code + 弹 alert；其他原样。
196| *
197| * @param e    invoke() 抛出的 unknown
198| * @param ctx  调用上下文（command 名 / 函数名），用于 console 前缀
199| * @param options.silent  已有 inline UI 时设 true（只 console，不 alert）
200| * @param options.onRetry 可恢复错误的重试回调（recoverable=true 时弹 confirm 询问）
201| */
202|export function handleCommandError(
203|  e: unknown,
204|  ctx?: string,
205|  options: HandleOptions = {}
206|): void {
207|  const prefix = ctx ? `[${ctx}]` : "[invoke]";
208|  if (isCommandError(e)) {
209|    console.error(
210|      `${prefix} CommandError code=${e.code} recoverable=${e.recoverable}`,
211|      e
212|    );
213|    if (options.silent) return;
214|    // 空 message 不弹空 alert——fallback 到 code，code 也空再兜底「未知错误」
215|    const msg = e.message.trim() ? e.message : e.code || "未知错误";
216|    const hint = hintForCode(e.code);
217|    const body = hint ? `${msg}\n\n💡 ${hint}` : msg;
218|    // recoverable 驱动 UI：可恢复 + 调用方给了重试回调 → confirm 提供「重试」选择；
219|    // 不可恢复（或无回调）→ alert + hint 引导（hint 已按 code 区分「去设置页」/「反馈日志」）
220|    if (e.recoverable && options.onRetry) {
221|      if (confirm(`❌ ${body}\n\n🔁 是否重试？`)) {
222|        try {
223|          options.onRetry();
224|        } catch (retryErr) {
225|          // 重试回调同步抛错不能逃出错误处理器本身——回收进同一入口
226|          // （silent：confirm 刚弹过，不二次弹窗）
227|          handleCommandError(retryErr, ctx, { silent: true });
228|        }
229|      }
230|    } else {
231|      alert(`❌ ${body}`);
232|    }
233|    return;
234|  }
235|  // 非结构化错误（一般是同步抛出的 JS 异常，未被 Rust 端包装）
236|  const msg = formatCommandError(e);
237|  console.error(`${prefix} ${msg || "(empty)"}`, e);
238|  if (options.silent) return;
239|  // msg 为空也兜底「未知错误」，不弹空 alert、也不静默跳过
240|  alert(`❌ ${msg || "未知错误"}`);
241|}
